Publish.LongDescription:
# Dedicated Turn Lanes Alpha
Dedicated Turn Lanes Alpha is an unlisted tester build for generating dedicated turn lane segments at selected intersections. Hover an intersection to preview eligible incoming roads, then apply the road split and replacement in one workflow.
**This is still an early alpha.** Recent work has focused mostly on stability fixes, so please back up important saves before testing.
## Current Road Matching Rules
The tool uses automatic matching rules by default:
* The tool looks for a compatible unlocked road variant with the **same road width** and a compatible lane layout. * The replacement road must provide **one extra incoming car lane** for the generated dedicated turn lane segment. * Matching supports vanilla roads and roads created with Road Builder, including both two-way and one-way roads. * The tool supports both right-hand and left-hand traffic.
## Custom Road Asset Match Rules
Use the **Road Asset Matches** panel to save preferred source-to-target road replacements when the automatic matcher picks the wrong asset. Rules can be scoped to tram, public transport, or reversed asymmetric source roads when those options are available.
## Credits
* Thanks to Network Tools by Luca for the network editing ideas and reference behavior that helped guide this mod. * Thanks to Traffic by krzychu124 for the lane connection systems and source references that helped shape Traffic integration.
